index.title: AI-gile: dty phossan AI, er un bord
index.description: Ta AI-gile ny vord kanban son possanyn coadee AI. T'ad gobbraghey choud as t'ou dty chadley; t'ou geddyn un charn veg dy reddyn dy reaghey, dy phrowal as dy ghoaill rish.
hero.alphaTitle: Moch as neuchooilleenit: gura mie ayd son prowal eh!
hero.lede: T'ad troggal choud as t'ou dty chadley. Tra t'ou dooisht, cha vel roish agh un charn veg: paart dy feyshtyn, paart dy reddyn dy phrowal, diamant purpur ny jees. Cliklee, gow rish, as er-ash gys dty chaffee.

f.pile.html: Ta Dhyts cummal dy chooilley nhee ta fuirraght ort, trooid dy chooilley phryjeck: feyshtyn, reddyn dy phrowal, obbraghyn nagh vod agh dooinney y yannoo. Ta dty streeu gra cre ta ry-heet as cre cho liauyr as nee eh goaill.
f.sleep.h: Possanyn ta gobbraghey choud as t'ou dty chadley
f.sleep.p: Ta leeideilagh as possan dy jaagentyn AI ec dy chooilley phryjeck. Cur gaghlin er cart as nee'n possan doostey, yn obbyr y yannoo, as cur er-ash eh lesh kesmadyn oddys dooinney skee geiyrt rish.
f.tester.p: Roish my roshys red erbee oo, ta fer-prowal geiyrt rish ny kesmadyn ayns coip jeh'n app as soilshaghey cre honnick eh, lesh screenshot. Jeeagh trooid ny fir hie trooid as gow rish ayns un chliklee.
f.proof.p: Ta dy chooilley chur harrish soilshaghey cre ta er chaghlaa: ny coadanyn, y diff, ny screenshots. Cha vel feme dy osley dy chooilley app dy akin vel eh jeant.
f.chat.p: Rail myr Discord: un ikon son dy chooilley phryjeck, diamantyn purpur son ny ta feme ort. Cur smooinaght gys leeideilagh; nee ad cartyn as plan jeh, lesh cramman ✅ Go.
f.tidy.p: Ta cartyn ta bentyn rish y cheilley cheet cooidjagh ayns fer, ta ard-ennymyn mearagh er nyn giartaghey, as ta jeeaghyn tokens freayll y coad caol. Ny sloo dy reddyn dy chaghlaa eddyr, ny sloo dy smooinaghtyn mychione.
f.private.li1: Ta'n bord roie er dty vashin hene as cha vel eh freggyrt agh uss.
f.private.li2: Ta DMyn preevaadjagh eddyr sleih ayns coad follit veih kione gys kione.
f.private.li3: Gyn coontyn, gyn trackeryn, gyn cookies.
f.lang.p: Erskyn 120 chengey, veih Ollanish, Bretnish as Shapaanish gys pirat, Yoda as Klingon, lesh caghlaa tappee er-ash gys Baarle son goan ny keirdey.
f.service.p: Hrog oo red ennagh lesh AI ta sleih jannoo ymmyd jeh nish? Cowree eh myr shirveish as nee'n bord cooney lhiat eh y reill dy mie: prowallyn traa ec obbyr, duillag stayd phobblagh, tecaghtyn lesh coontey screeuit, caghlaaghyn ta feme oc er Go, coipyn-sauchys jeeaghit gagh laa. Ta Cooney ynsaghey dhyt gagh kesmad myr t'ou goll.
msgr.h2: AI-gile Messenger: dty phossan ayns dty phoggaid
msgr.p1: Loayr rish dty phossan AI gyn y bord y osley. Loayr rish leeideilee dty phryjeckyn as rish dty chaarjyn, as jeeagh er kesmadyn prowal cart as freggyr ad, ooilley veih dty hellvane.
msgr.p2: Dy chiangley eh, scan coad QR er dty vord. Y chied cheayrt? Nee co-loayrtys demo caarjagh soilshaghey dhyt mygeayrt.

msgr.b3: 1. Foshil Soiaghyn. 2. Reih Dorraghey. Vel eh jeeaghyn kiart?
